position_rules.basis: every position cites its information basis (surface + record/artifact ref, per the speculation registration); uncited = invalid position
position_rules.settlement: observed outcome per the subject's resolution source vs the position; settle action; settlement does not bypass dual-gate

scope_guard: internal only; no real money, no external wagering; #407 trading freeze untouched
